title: Trophies

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Trophies are items dropped by defeated creatures and can stack to 20.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
All trophies have some shared uses:
• They can be attached to Item stands to serve as decorations.
• They can be used to program the Ballista.
• All trophies will give 1 Coal per trophy if used in an Obliterator.
Some trophies have special usage:
• Some are used as crafting ingredients.
• Some are used to summon Forsaken.
Each Forsaken is guaranteed to drop a special trophy when defeated that can be returned to the Sacrificial Stones to unlock a new Forsaken power.

sections.heading: Quotes
sections.text: Forsaken trophies have a 5% chance every minute to speak a quote.

table_data.Quote: So you were my death? You look so small and soft… Tell Odin he may have broken this form but the wilderness will never submit to his rules...
Little thing of blood and bone, I should have snapped you like a twig! Now I wither and die, let the great tree have me...
Thank you, warrior. We who lived on in this shape were denied the peace of death for too long. We go now...
Sheathe your pride, creature of Odin! My long reign is at an end but those who come after me are greater still...
Do you come to gloat, little thing? Do you know how many times I have been killed, broken, banished, burned and buried? You are not the first and you will not be the last.
Tell Odin that my kin will bring forth another... A monarch never dies.
I followed a false destiny, and it gave me nothing but ruin. Forgive me, my love...
